text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed the feasibility and is recommending the installation of speed bumps in the public lane north of Dupont Street, west of Osler Street (north-south).

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the public lane, west of Osler Street, between lane north of Dupont Street, west of Osler Street (east-west) and lane south of Cariboo Avenue, west of Osler Street, as shown in Attachment 1, Drawing TC-136 dated April 2023, to the report (May 5, 2023) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
